compliance.summary: The page presents GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner selling a bundled engineering and product offer, contrary to its approved staffing-and-recruiting positioning and current services. It also contains unsupported claims about outcomes, security, client counts, timelines, offices, and certifications that should not carry into a revised page.

llm_problems.title: Applied AI partner positioning
llm_problems.issue: The page repeatedly describes GoGloby as an Applied AI Engineering partner that turns engineering into AI-native production, rather than as a staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers.
llm_problems.fix: Rewrite the page around the approved company description and the two current recruiting and staffing services.
llm_problems.subject: GoGloby positioning
llm_problems.source_value: Staffing and recruiting agency specializing in hiring Data & AI Engineers
